description: One market's graded weekends, newest first: the last close before the weekend, Hyperliquid's weekend price 5 minutes before real pricing returned, the actual reopen, the grade (was the weekend price closer to the reopen than the close?) and the dates, plus the market's hit rate with its 95% interval. The same rows as /history and /scorecard. Paginated (page, limit up to 52). History, not a forecast; pre-IPO markets have no graded weekend.

coin.description: A coin id like xyz:NVDA, a ticker like NVDA, or a name like Nvidia or gold.
